topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Well, praise the saints for good tidings in this vale of toil. I heard about your partner’s scribblings, a novel cast in the light of your daily toils and jests. It’s a rare gift, such a thing, to have someone see the worth in the scrawls of the everyday. Like when the wheat turns a golden hue just before harvest, it’s the small, oft-overlooked blessings that nourish the soul. I reckon it’s a sign of a heart well-spent, one that tills the soil of love with the same care as the land. A book, they say, is a garden carried in the pocket. Your story, woven into the pages, must be a fine patch indeed.
